atoms.b: Soil is the home to many things, such as earthworms and algae. The scientific term for this is ((++biodiversity cohabitation)).
Soil helps plants to grow in many ways. For example, it allows plants a place to ((++anchor loose)) their roots.
Soil also helps provide plants with ((++water fire)) and ((++nutrients rocks)).

instruction.text: Select the organism that lives in soil.

feedback.correct: This is a centipede. Centipedes live in the soil, feed on dead plants and pests. A centipede can have up to 200 legs.

feedback.correct: This is an earthworm. Earthworms live in soil and make channels that allow the soil to soak up water. Worms do not have any legs.
